# Product Carousel

`commerce/product-carousel` &middot; section-level &middot; category: commerce

## Purpose

A static, email-safe stand-in for a carousel: a compact row of products with a view-all button. Not interactive, because email clients do not run JavaScript.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `products` | products |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Three compact products across, two per row on phones.
- **wide**: Four across. Sets `columns: 4`.
- **cards**: Three across with full product cards. Sets `gridVariant: default`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileColumns` | one of `2`, `1` | `2` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `columns` | one of `3`, `2`, `4` | `3` |
| `gridVariant` | one of `minimal`, `default`, `luxury`, `editorial`, `playful` | `"minimal"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileColumns`: `2`, `1`. How many columns per row on phones.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A plain row of products, no interaction. | Works everywhere, nothing interactive. Two per row on phones uses a media query. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('commerce/product-carousel', {
  "heading": "You might also like",
  "products": [
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/300x300/png?text=Linen%20Shirt",
        "alt": "A sand linen shirt"
      },
      "name": "Linen Shirt",
      "price": "$120.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/linen-shirt"
    },
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/300x300/png?text=Canvas%20Tote",
        "alt": "A navy canvas tote"
      },
      "name": "Canvas Tote",
      "price": "$68.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/canvas-tote"
    },
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/300x300/png?text=Wool%20Socks",
        "alt": "Grey merino socks"
      },
      "name": "Wool Socks",
      "price": "$32.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/wool-socks"
    },
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/300x300/png?text=Cotton%20Tee",
        "alt": "A white cotton tee"
      },
      "name": "Cotton Tee",
      "price": "$45.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/cotton-tee"
    },
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/300x300/png?text=Denim%20Shorts",
        "alt": "Light denim shorts"
      },
      "name": "Denim Short",
      "price": "$78.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/denim-shorts"
    },
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/300x300/png?text=Sun%20Hat",
        "alt": "A straw sun hat"
      },
      "name": "Sun Hat",
      "price": "$54.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/sun-hat"
    }
  ],
  "cta": {
    "label": "See the whole collection",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/all"
  }
}) ]]
```
